slides.title: The negotiator.
slides.body: Offers to split the reps evenly. Somehow you end up with all the burpees.

slides.title: The sprinter.
slides.body: Flies through round one, tags you in gasping. You get rounds two through five.

slides.title: The cheerleader.
slides.body: Encouragement is constant and very loud. Reps, slightly less so.

slides.title: The accountant.
slides.body: Counts every rep out loud. Yours, strictly. Theirs, generously.

slides.title: The tag-out artist.
slides.body: Five reps, tap out. Four reps, tap out. Three reps and a long look at the clock.

slides.title: The carrier.
slides.body: Does most of the work, says it was dead even, and means it.
